description: Known exploited vulnerabilities (CISA KEV) — Check whether a CVE is confirmed exploited in the wild, search the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog by vendor or product, or list what was added recently. Each entry has the federal patch due date, ransomware use, required action and an EPSS exploit-probability score. For patch-priority and vulnerability-management agents. Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).

cve.description: optional CVE id to check, e.g. CVE-2024-3400

q.description: optional vendor or product search, e.g. fortinet

name: security_kev
